Split by class (pooled it looks flat -- the two classes move in opposite directions and cancel): missed hate median 85 transcript words vs 227 for caught hate (~2.7x less speech); flagged non-hate 171.5 vs 47 for correctly-passed non-hate (~3.6x more). FN1 speech-poor visual hate n=7 (+0.0326) -- image stream alone right on 5/7 in >=1 seed, text right on 0/7; only user-gated CLAP could carry non-speech audio. HateMM STREAM READS (head-space, post-hoc sub-spaces): text-only 0.8822 (val-sel) / 0.8853 (final) vs deployed 0.8775/0.8760 = +0.0047 (sign 2/3) / +0.0093 (sign 3/3), image-only 0.7426/0.7411 -- both deltas inside the +-0.014 seed band and far under the +0.030 bar => MEASURED-NOT-PROMOTED, value is as the honest paper ABLATION (a paper-grade text-only arm needs a properly trained text-only head). The gap is EXACTLY 2 test items in every seed: the dev argmax is 0.8718 = 68/78 in all three seeds and epoch 29 sits 1-2 dev items below it, so the protocol discards the final epoch on a deficit of one or two items out of 78 and pays exactly two test items out of 149 for doing so, three times over. (i) The dev signal is not weak but ANTI-CORRELATED with the objective -- Spearman dev-vs-test accuracy over the 25 legal epochs = -0.3457 / +0.0419 / -0.1531 per seed, POOLED -0.2402 with p = 0.0380 (significantly negative); a selector reading it is pointed the wrong way. (ii) Val-selection recovers only +0.65 test items over a UNIFORMLY RANDOM legal epoch (0.8322 vs 0.8278), i.e. essentially nil information content, while the final epoch buys +2.7 items (0.8456) and lands within 0.0023 acc (0.34 items) of the per-seed test-ORACLE epoch -- there is almost nothing left for any selection rule to win. A protocol whose output is not stable under floating-point reduction order is not measuring the model. Retirement = MEASURED +0.0134 acc / +0.0159 mF1, 3/3 seeds. RULE-SHOPPING EXPOSURE DOCUMENTED: retirement converts exactly one verdict in our own favour (ZH val-sel FAIL -> not applicable); mitigated but not eliminated by costing nothing elsewhere (HateMM passes BOTH protocols per F53, EN fails both per F55, so no other verdict moves); the defensible framing is 'the ZH dev split is too small and too anti-aligned to function as a model-selection instrument, per (i)-(v), so single-protocol final-epoch reporting is the methodologically sound reading', NOT 'ZH passes if we drop val-sel'. USER RULING PENDING. Also: 14 distinct test items (9.4%) ever change prediction between the two protocols, only 5 of them in the stable error core, and 23.5-28.2% of the ZH test set is epoch-labile over the legal window -- both protocols draw from that pool and the final-epoch rule simply draws from the top of it. || ZH OTHER. Streams (raw banked, single draw): image-only 0.7047, text-only 0.8523 (AUC 0.9171), L2-concat fused 0.8456 = EXACTLY the deployed 3-seed mean, i.e. the trained RGCL head buys ~0 accuracy over a raw-key kNN vote on ZH and what it does is sharpen margins in both directions (diagnostic, pre-head, must not be quoted as a floor). Core-error cross-tab: neither stream right 8 (irreducible in the banked representation), exactly one right 12 (+0.0805 but F47-closed at all 3 supervision sources, F66 arithmetic), both right and deployed wrong 2 (F85 concat null, F50 fixed composition). Covariates: the ONE real cluster is THIN TRANSCRIPT -- Q2 band [31,76) chars holds 11 of the 22 core errors in 37 items, 2.0x enrichment, permutation p = 0.0048 (50k perms, robust to the cut) -- enough text to dominate a text-dominant fused key, too little to individuate. The 'empty or off-topic description' hypothesis is REFUTED: zero ZH test items have an empty text channel, 0 of 149 Whisper ASR outputs are empty (ZH audio always has speech), error rate is NON-MONOTONE in text length with both extreme quartiles the best groups, and the 7 title-only items error BELOW the transcript-present rate. Within-positive wall INVERTS the EN pattern: Hateful n=17 errs 0.2941 (5 core) ABOVE Offensive n=28 at 0.2500 (7 core), so there is no Offensive-specific error mass to reallocate (consistent with F82's ZH graded oracle +0.0256 < bar). Two suggestive-but-underpowered readings recorded as hypotheses only: <em>-markup topic-vs-stance FPs (5 observed vs 4.57 expected, p = 0.5022) and keyword-absent positives missed more often (6 vs 3.47 expected, p = 0.0681, hinting at a largely lexical slur-matching text channel); ASR-corrupted transcripts not significant (p = 0.2552); duration flat. || EN = LABEL-SEMANTICS MISMATCH, NOT A REPRESENTATION DEFICIT (deployed arm = frozen-Qwen + archive-kNN a0.25, val-selected, 4 seeds -- NOT CLIP and NOT LoRA, which fails both protocols on EN). Consensus-error clusters over the 22: C1 vote-locked NON-GROUP-HARM Offensive misses 9 = 40.9% (+0.0559; harm is sexual/abusive/vulgar with no protected-group target, so the positive side of the bank -- dominated by group-targeted hate -- has nothing to match them to; purity 0-14%, one item has literally zero positive neighbours in its top-20); C2 borderline Offensive 2; C3 genuine Hateful misses 3 (+0.0186, incl. one fusion-cancellation miss where the raw text stream votes correctly and both fused Qwen and fused CLIP are wrong on all seeds); C4 lexical-surface FPs where PROFANITY != HATE 5 (+0.0311); C5 counter-speech / meta-commentary FPs 2; C6 gold-label-disputed FP 1 (model, MLLM archive card, and arguably a reasonable annotator all disagree with the release label); C7 long-transcript dilution cross-cuts 9 of the 22 -- consensus error rate rises monotonically across transcript-word quartiles (9.52% / 10.26% / 12.50% / 22.50%) with Q4 positive recall 0.4792, and EMPTY transcripts are NOT a driver (1 of 11), so the failure mode is the OPPOSITE of the obvious hypothesis: long transcripts dilute a mean-pooled 3584-d text vector until the hateful span stops dominating; C8 seed-noise band 20 items = 33.8% of the average seed's 33.25 errors while being no individual item's stable failure (cross-seed ensembles user-banned). The EN image stream is INERT FOR THE POSITIVE CLASS, not merely weak: raw image-only 20-NN votes positive on 11.80% of items against a 30.43% base rate with positive recall 0.2449 and mF1 0.5899 -- so 6 of the 7 'image-only rescues' among the consensus errors are true NEGATIVES (worthless under an 88.2% negative-prediction bias) and the naive stream-selection ceiling 10/22 = +0.0621 DEFLATES to 4/22 = +0.0248. Encoder selection: 33 items disagree near-symmetrically between frozen-Qwen and frozen-CLIP at the final epoch (18 Qwen-wrong/CLIP-right = +0.1118 ceiling, independently reproducing F47's dev oracle +0.1083), i.e. F44's 'EN = rotation, not Pareto' at item granularity; mechanistic reason the closures were inevitable: the 'second opinion' the oracle exploits is largely the image stream being constantly negative, so a selector cannot learn 'trust the image stream' without learning 'predict the majority class'. The whole trained stack buys only ~+0.011 acc / +0.005 mF1 over a raw text 20-NN with no head at all. Archive-card forensics: the mechanism field separates FPs strongly (Normal items whose card lists slur/insult/dehumanization/threat/mockery FP at 0.1875 vs 0.0250 for the rest, a 7.5x ratio) but the card AGREES WITH THE MODEL, so adding archive-card mechanism features would REINFORCE these FPs rather than fix them; target_groups is degenerate (152/161 empty) and was deliberately excluded after base-rate checking (the surface reading '12 of 14 FNs have no target group' is a base-rate trap). EN protocol option quantified and NOT RECOMMENDED: excluding Offensive buys +0.0605 headline accuracy but LOSES -0.0401 macro-F1 (positive rate falls to 10.4%, 13 test videos, 1 video = 0.0080) and breaks comparability with every published MultiHateClip number. || LEDGER CORRECTIONS (4). (a) THE BANKED EN MEMORY-EDITING POSITIVE IS SINGLE-SEED. Exact multi-seed replay on the banked top-60 lists (un-edited replay reproduces each seed's floor acc to <1e-12): the 2-entry human deletion gives +0.0124 on seed 0 and EXACTLY ZERO vote flips on seeds 1/2/3, 4-seed mean +0.0031; seed 0 reproduces the banked demo exactly (0.8074534161490683 -> 0.8198757763975155, mF1 0.7625707625707625 -> 0.7748468920287408, matching research-wiki/DEMO_memory_editing.md:52) and the two items it flips are NAMED FOR THE FIRST TIME (cYQyH7hbNnw, xqilG4oMvvI) -- both low-margin FPs from the C8 noise band, NEITHER a hard error. The 14-id rule-hit list is strictly STRONGER: +0.0093 mean acc / +0.0089 mF1, 3/4 seeds positive, 6 items fixed, 0 BROKEN on any seed (DEMO_memory_editing.md's 'the other 12 rule-hit ids are inert' is true on SEED 0 ONLY -- they are worth +0.0186 and +0.0062 on seeds 1 and 2) -- but it is 3x under the +0.030 bar, inside the +-0.014 seed band, now test-consumed, and a legitimate dev-side pregate is arithmetically impossible because dev n=80 makes 1 item = 0.0125 and cannot resolve a +0.009 effect. CONSEQUENCE: wherever the pillar-4 auditable/editable-archive claim is cited, it must be cited as a SINGLE-SEED DEMO. (b) F78's '$0 curation premise FALSE' DOES NOT HOLD FOR EN DELETION-ONLY EDITS: p2_out/cache_MHC_s{0..3}.json bank the top-60 neighbour lists in the DEPLOYED archive-kNN key space for all 4 deployed seeds, which supports exact, $0, multi-seed, deletion-only bank replay (demonstrated above). F78's limitation is real but NARROWER than stated -- it applies to bank ADDITIONS, key-space changes and re-training, not to pruning; if EN curation is ever revisited it is a $0 CPU job, not a GPU re-mint. (c) F77 L2 REFINED: the deployed ZH text is the harvested TITLE (carrying the <em class="keyword"> search-term markup, medians: title 15 chars, transcript 76, composed 96) concatenated with MultiHateClip's OWN speech transcript, which is itself ASR-derived and visibly noisy (wrong-language output, repetition loops); F77's 'not Whisper ASR' is right only in the narrow sense that it is not OUR data/ASR/ run. (d) INFRA: the HateMM align head trains AND evaluates end-to-end in 52 s of wall time on 8 CPUs (30 epochs, 60 retrieval evals, on banked features) -- the whole 3-seed proxy family cost ~2.6 CPU-minutes and zero GPU. F78's '~0.3 GPU-h head re-mint' is repriced at ~1 CPU-minute per seed, so EVERY head-side diagnostic, ablation, calibration variant, curation variant and purity read is now available at CPU-minute cost under full 3-seed discipline without touching the GPU allocation. BINDING CAVEAT: CPU-trained heads are NOT bit-exact to the CUDA floor (-0.0031 final-epoch acc here), so a CPU-trained arm must be paired against a CPU-TRAINED FLOOR, never against the banked GPU floor -- the same same-path-floors discipline F87 established after the merge-drift incident. || VERDICT. The genuinely-open, in-box, $0 set is EMPTY ON ALL THREE DATASETS: every cluster maps to a closed axis, a vetoed channel, an arithmetic cap below the bar, or a user gate, and the three candidates the error structure itself suggested were measured HERE and all three came back null (threshold recalibration, length de-bias, memory-bank curation-with-a-control). QUANTIFIED GATED CEILINGS, ranked: (1) CLAP general-audio on HateMM FN1 = +0.0326, the only channel defined by the ABSENCE of the signal every existing channel carries (30/30 empty-transcript items predicted non-hate in 6/6 cells) -- but downweight heavily, the audio axis has already returned zero conditional information over Z_best twice (F41 eGeMAPS prosody, F64 Whisper-encoder), so run the same $0 conditional-info pregate on CLAP embeddings BEFORE any GPU if the download gate opens; no general-audio representation exists locally today. (2) MNTP stage-2 = +0.0233 (HateMM FN3) to +0.0465 (plus the text-stream failures inside FN1/FN2), the last unmeasured lever that changes the TEXT REPRESENTATION ITSELF rather than the head or the routing, with F72's Llama-pattern bidir crater as the standing warning and F87 having just refuted the adjacent text-side bet at the routing level. (3) ZH protocol retirement = +0.0134 acc / +0.0159 mF1, 3/3 seeds, measured not oracle -- a USER RULING, not an experiment. PAPER VALUE banked independently of any of that: the mechanism sentence 'the errors are neighbourhood inversions with the right analogue at rank ~1, not coverage gaps and not boundary cases' is the per-item face of law-I and explains why every reranking, reweighting and calibration lever measured across this project returned null; plus the HateMM FP1 annotation-scheme boundary, the EN label-semantics ceiling statement, and the honest text-only-vs-fused ablation reading on HateMM and ZH.

body: RECORD: refine-logs/MECHFIX_PREGATE_2026-07-27.md (commit 110dff8; record dated 2026-07-27 NZST, run and ledgered 2026-07-26 UTC). MACHINERY: scripts/analysis/mechfix_ops.py — FROZEN, sha256 635c13124e79ba1a299bc13fc1175a03aa11e09924f5413ce51061793c83fc8d, 197 lines, frozen before any treatment number existed — plus mechfix_run.py (harness: head loading, parity gates, train-side sanity, test/dev reads, flip accounting), mechfix_diag.py (mechanism diagnostics), outputs mechfix_{hatemm,zh,en,diag}_OUT.json. COST $0: CPU only ≤8 threads, zero GPU, zero SLURM, zero Modal, zero training of any arm, and no test-fitted quantity anywhere (no oracle, no threshold search, no per-item branch, no test label). || DESIGN. Five eval-time decision-operator replacements for the deployed decision (src/utils/metrics.py:262-301, src/model/evaluate_rac.py:405-465 = top-20 rank-weighted signed-cosine vote, w=[20..1], over a faiss IndexFlatIP search on float32 L2-normalised fused head keys, memory = own train split, predict 1 iff vote ≥ 0): T1 class-balanced quota (top-10 of EACH class separately, w=[10..1], predict hate iff score_hate ≥ score_nonhate; total budget 20 = deployed); T2a CSLS hubness correction (adjsim = 2·cos − r(x) with bank-side r = mean cosine to the 10 nearest other bank items, train-only, Lample-2018 default); T2b Ledoit-Wolf whitened keys (sklearn.covariance.LedoitWolf fit on the train bank, closed-form shrinkage = no free parameter, re-L2-normalised, deployed vote unchanged); T3 exact 1-D length-direction excision (least-squares direction of log1p(transcript volume) on train-bank keys, no labels, projected out of bank+query keys); T4 = T2b whitening then the T1 class-balanced vote. All five are GLOBAL SYMMETRIC operators in the deployed head key space, literature-default constants, no tuning of anything. Transcript volume = whitespace tokens (HateMM, MHC-EN) / characters of the composed Title+Transcript text (MHC-ZH). PAIRED SAME-HEAD: for each dataset × seed × protocol, the deployed vote and every treatment vote are computed from the SAME head, features, memory bank, similarity engine and floating-point path; Δ = metric(arm) − metric(deployed) per seed is the claim object and absolute accuracies are proxy-grade context only. Engine uniformity: every arm draws its cosines from the same faiss index the deployed path uses, so no arm-to-arm Δ can be a similarity-engine artefact. STRUCTURAL-DISTINCTNESS AUDIT run arm-by-arm against every dead lever it could be confused with — global decision threshold (dead all 3 datasets), train-LOO logistic vote recalibration (−0.0016/−0.0017), length-logistic SCORE de-bias (−0.0016 train-LOO / +0.0000 dev), LOO bank curation (measured null, fails its own random-deletion control), the NCA/soft-kNN TRAINED loss family (F75), per-item selection/routing (F47; F66's 91-98% selection-lock), and the fusion-operator axis (F83/F85) — with no arm dropped; the load-bearing entry is T3-vs-score-level-length-de-bias, since T3 acts on the GEOMETRY BEFORE retrieval and therefore changes the retrieved neighbour set, which is exactly what ERRPAT-HateMM §4.3 pointed at ('the bias lives in the retrieval geometry, not in a monotone miscalibration of the score'). || GATES (test-touch discipline: §1-§2 of the record and the ops sha256 frozen before any treatment number existed). FLOOR PARITY as hard asserts that abort the run: 15/15 test cells PASS at 4dp and 15/15 dev cells PASS. Cells: HateMM (test n=215, train bank V=744) on errpat CPU PROXY heads, val-sel epochs {25,15,29} + final epoch 29, 3 seeds; MHC-ZH (n=149, V=579) on errpat CPU RE-MINT heads, PRIMARY = final-epoch ep29 (the only device-reproducible readout per ERRPAT-ZH §0.2) + secondary val-sel using the re-mint's OWN dev argmax (epochs 5/19/6); MHC-EN (n=161, V=549) on the ARM-F snapshot heads refine-logs/router_ckpt_snapshot/MHC_Qwen_s{0,1,2}_e29.pt, final-epoch, 3 seeds. ops_sha256 recorded inside all three OUT jsons. || RESULT: 0 of 15 arm×dataset cells clears the house bar (+0.030 acc AND +0.030 mF1, 3/3 seeds, on ≥1 dataset). Primary-protocol 3-seed mean Δacc/ΔmF1 — deployed floors HateMM 0.8760/0.8699, ZH 0.8456/0.8158, EN 0.7847/0.7425: T1 +0.0000/+0.0000 (HateMM), +0.0000/+0.0000 (ZH), +0.0021/+0.0031 (EN); T2a +0.0000/+0.0000, +0.0000/+0.0000, −0.0021/−0.0032; T2b −0.0078/−0.0097, +0.0000/−0.0053, −0.0104/−0.0395; T3 +0.0000/+0.0000 on all three; T4 −0.0046/−0.0060, +0.0067/+0.0052, +0.0041/−0.0122. HateMM val-selected (the protocol on which the proxy is exact at 4dp vs the floor, deployed 0.8775/0.8715) agrees: T1/T2a/T3 all +0.0000, T2b −0.0155/−0.0187, T4 −0.0062/−0.0080. BEST NUMBER ANYWHERE = T4 on MHC-ZH, +0.0067 acc / +0.0052 mF1 — 4.5× under the bar, inside the ±0.014 project seed band, sign pattern +0+ on acc but +−+ on mF1 (so not 3/3), on a proxy head, dev Δ +0.0043 — reported as a SUB-BAR POSITIVE, not a lead. Free same-head dev corroboration (no selection made on it) agrees with the negative verdicts on HateMM and EN (T2b −0.0062 / −0.0667, T4 −0.0062 / −0.0625, EN 3/3 negative signs); the single disagreement is ZH-final T2b (dev +0.0128 with 3/3 positive signs) where at n=78 one item = 0.0128, i.e. one video per seed, and it does not survive the 149-item test split. || MECHANISM — the actual product of the battery, three door-closers and one new structural fact, all at zero GPU. (a) T1 is DEGENERATE, not merely null: its predictions equal the deployed predictions on 215/215 (HateMM) and 149/149 (ZH) items in EVERY seed, differing on only 1/4/0 of 161 EN items, and an independent float64 numpy re-implementation with no faiss in the loop (mechfix_diag.py:t1_numpy_control) agrees with the frozen faiss implementation on 161/161 + 149/149 + 215/215 predictions in all 9 cells (max margin difference 2.2e-7), so this is not an implementation artefact. Reason, visible in the per-class scores: the between-class gap (HateMM s0 median class-0 score 0.999890 vs class-1 0.994208) is two orders of magnitude larger than the within-class dispersion, so sign(score_hate − score_nonhate) and the deployed rank-weighted signed sum over the mixed top-20 are THE SAME STATISTIC on this data — both also agree with the plain top-1-neighbour-label rule on 204/215 HateMM items. CONSEQUENCE, which sharpens the errpat diagnosis: the 'local class prior' is NOT a removable bias sitting on top of a good retrieval signal that a per-class quota can strip; in this cone-collapsed geometry the base-rate structure and the signal are the same statistic. Train-side sanity separately shows T1 does not collapse to one class (LOO pos-rate 0.4019 vs bank 0.4005) and its LOO train accuracy is identical to the deployed LOO accuracy (0.9476). (b) T2a is INERT: bank-side hubness r(x) has IQR 1.0e-4 to 1.4e-4 (HateMM), 2.4-3.4e-4 (ZH), 3.8-8.8e-4 (EN) over range [0.9829, 0.999994] — the cone collapse leaves the hubness statistic essentially no dynamic range. It changes the retrieved top-20 SET on 88-114 of 215 HateMM and 98-114 of 161 EN items while flipping 0-4 decisions: the neighbours it swaps are label-interchangeable. (c) T3 is INERT and informatively so — NEW STRUCTURAL FACT. The length direction is fitted exactly (Pearson(projection, log-length) = 1.0000 on train) and excised exactly (|residual projection| ≤ 8.6e-9), and it carries essentially none of the key variance (variance share 3.4e-15 to 7.2e-15 HateMM, 3.6-6.2e-14 ZH, 8.4e-14 to 5.9e-13 EN). Yet the errpat length statistic ρ(query transcript volume, median volume of its top-20 retrieved bank rows) moves by ≤0.004 in 9/9 cells: HateMM 0.5805/0.5005/0.4924 → 0.5808/0.5006/0.4965, ZH 0.3667/0.4813/0.3986 → 0.3671/0.4805/0.4005, EN 0.1794/0.2939/0.1717 → 0.1813/0.2947/0.1686; and not one prediction changes in 9/9 cells. ⇒ THE LENGTH ORGANISATION OF RETRIEVAL IS NOT CARRIED BY ANY SINGLE LINEAR DIRECTION of the deployed key space: the axis is exactly decodable and yet not 1-D-excisable, so the 1-D excision specified for T3 is structurally incapable of reaching it and its null is explained rather than merely observed. This closes the GEOMETRY-level 1-D version of the length lever, complementing the SCORE-level version already dead at ERRPAT-HateMM §4.3/§6.2. (The deployed HateMM s0 value ρ=0.5805 independently reproduces ERRPAT-HateMM §4.3's ρ=0.5817 on the proxy head.) (d) T2b is NEGATIVE with a measured mechanism. It de-collapses the cone decisively (train top-1 sim 0.9999 → 0.5220 HateMM, 0.9999 → 0.53-0.61 ZH, 0.9996 → 0.39-0.46 EN) — but at d=1024 > n=744/579/549 the closed-form LW shrinkage is only 0.00041/0.0011/0.0027 (eigen-condition 2.4e6 / 9.0e5 / 3.5e5), so the whitener amplifies near-null eigendirections ~1000-1800× and the length axis is one of them: whitening RAISES the length organisation from ρ≈0.52 to ρ≈0.87 (HateMM 0.8770/0.8489/0.8686), 0.37-0.48 → 0.80-0.82 (ZH), 0.17-0.29 → 0.66-0.70 (EN). The literature-default whitener promotes exactly the nuisance axis the diagnosis flagged. Verdict backed by a negative 3-seed mean mF1 on all three datasets and dev-corroborated negatives on HateMM and EN. COROLLARY binding on any future 'fix the collapsed geometry' proposal: the variance ordering of the key space is doing useful work, and flattening it surfaces the nuisance axis first. (e) T2b and T4 are the FIRST levers measured in this project to REACH the documented stable-core errors — they fix 1-3 per cell of the HateMM 25-item and MHC-ZH 22-item 3/3-seed cores and 2-5 per cell of the MHC-EN 22-item ARM-V consensus set, which no lever in the errpat reports managed — but they break at least as many previously-correct items in almost every cell: net items ≤0 in 12 of the 18 T2b/T4 seed cells, and the 3-seed mean Δ is negative or ~0 on every dataset (HateMM T2b net −1/−4/0, T4 −2/−2/+1; ZH T2b +2/−1/−1, T4 +2/0/+1; EN T2b −7/+4/−2, T4 −1/+3/0). That fix-some/break-more shape is THE SAME ARITHMETIC F47/F66 priced for per-item channel selection and ERRPAT-HateMM §3.2 measured for the image stream (fixes 11-14, breaks 40-43): the information to fix the core exists in the space, and every symmetric way of surfacing it costs at least as much elsewhere — realising it would again require the per-item selection the campaign has closed. || VERDICT: BATCH 0-FOR-5, no arm promotable, none reaching half the bar on any dataset. The EVAL-TIME VOTE-OPERATOR AXIS IS NOW CLOSED AS MEASURED, not assumed: class-balancing, hubness correction and whitening are the three standard eval-time repairs for exactly the pathology the errpat reports diagnosed (local class prior, hub-proneness, cone collapse), and all three are now measured on all three datasets under a paired same-head design with 15/15 floor-parity gates passed. This is the RETRIEVAL-LEVEL closure of the family; previous closures were SCORE-level (global thresholds, train-LOO logistic recalibration, length-logistic score de-bias). The genuinely-open in-box $0 set this pregate was probing is EMPTY, and it closes at $0 rather than at a queue slot — F88's 'in-box $0 open set empty on all 3 datasets' now stands with mechanism proofs attached. Live user decisions unchanged: ZH val-sel protocol retirement (+0.0134 acc / +0.0159 mF1, 3/3 seeds, measured not oracle — a ruling, not an experiment), and the gated levers CLAP general-audio / MNTP stage-2 / Molmo2. || LIMITATIONS (from the record, §7, carried verbatim in substance). (1) PROXY AND SNAPSHOT HEADS, NOT THE DEPLOYED FLOORS: HateMM and MHC-ZH are errpat CPU proxies (floor ckpts deleted per F78), MHC-EN is the ARM-F snapshot recompute; the paired same-head Δ design makes the proxy-vs-floor offset irrelevant to the Δ and all 15 cells reproduce their recorded anchors at 4dp, but a Δ measured on a proxy head is not proof of the same Δ on the floor head — this is a PREGATE, not a verdict. (2) MHC-EN's headline stack (ARM-V, val-selected, 4 seeds) was NOT measurable: its head ckpt is gone and only top-60 neighbour lists are banked, which cannot support any of these operators (all need full-bank similarities or a re-projection), so EN is ARM-F / final-epoch / 3 seeds and the EN core-error overlap read in §5 compares against an ARM-V-defined core in a DIFFERENT key space. (3) T3's spec is under-determined at d>n: the least-squares direction is an interpolating solution that fits log-length exactly by construction and lands in a ~1e-14-variance subspace, so the measured null is a null ABOUT THAT CONSTRUCTION — a ridge-regularised direction, a whitened-space direction, or a multi-dimensional length subspace were NOT tested and each would be a new arm needing its own freeze; what is construction-independent is the ρ-invariance in (c), which is a property of the retrieval. (4) SINGLE DETERMINISTIC DRAW per cell, no resampling and no CI; 1 test item = 0.0047 (HateMM) / 0.0067 (ZH) / 0.0062 (EN), so every non-zero Δ above is 1-7 videos. (5) ZH val-sel-epoch rows are SECONDARY and sit inside the 78-item dev epoch lottery (re-mint dev argmax 5/19/6, not the banked run's 20/26/19, because pairing a GPU-selected epoch with a CPU head would compare two paths); on that protocol the arms look most active and most random (up to 20 items flipped per seed, signs both ways) and it carries no weight. (6) T1/T2a/T3's exact zeros are a property of THIS geometry — cone-collapsed 1024-d Hadamard-fused RGCL keys with these banks — not a general claim that class-balanced voting or CSLS are useless operators. (7) The dev reads are corroboration only; no config, epoch, threshold or arm was selected using them. (8) The pregate itself read and wrote NOTHING under autoresearch/goal_mllm_plus3/state/, deleted or moved no file, and submitted zero GPU / SLURM / Modal work.

(1) THE VISION TOWER GENUINELY IMPROVED: Molmo2 raw img kNN 0.7814/0.7689 vs B 0.7256/0.7112 and C 0.7163/0.7014 — the SigLIP2 video-native tower does exactly what the literature advertises. (2) IT BOUGHT NOTHING: the trained head still lands 0.0217 BELOW the floor. (3) CONE COLLAPSE GOT WORSE, NOT BETTER: top-1 cosine rises from Qwen's 0.9439-0.9686 to 0.9881-0.9999 (img 0.9960, text 0.9881, concat 0.9904, hadamard 0.9999) — the pathology F89 named as the thing that must change MOVED IN THE WRONG DIRECTION; Molmo2's keys are more nearly parallel than Qwen's. (4) THE SPECTRUM SIMULTANEOUSLY GOT BROADER: participation ratio rises (text 27.870 vs 23.071; concat 33.607 vs 22.337) and leading-direction variance share falls (concat 0.1126 vs 0.1670) — variance spread over MORE directions while top-1 neighbours are MORE saturated = a different geometry, not a better-conditioned one for retrieval. (5) THE NUISANCE AXIS SURVIVED INTACT: text-stream length-organisation rho = +0.9052 vs +0.9432 (B) / +0.9530 (C); retrieval is still almost entirely ordered by transcript length and swapping the encoder does not touch the axis F89/F88 identified. (6) RAW HADAMARD DEGENERATES: Molmo2's elementwise product collapses to acc 0.5628 with PR 3.069 and top-1 cosine 0.9999 — two near-parallel streams multiplied together annihilate the signal; the deployed fusion is Hadamard but in HEAD space after learned projections, so this is diagnostic rather than deployed, and it is nonetheless the most plausible mechanism for why the BEST raw fused read of all three arms (Molmo2 concat 0.8186 vs 0.8140 / 0.8000) trains to a WORSE head. || WHAT THIS CLOSES: the encoder swap was one of the two remaining entry points F89 left open after every post-representation repair was closed, and this probe closes it AT THE STRONGEST AVAILABLE CANDIDATE — a 2025-generation, video-native, SigLIP2-towered 8B model, on the ONE dataset (HateMM) where encoder identity had ever converted before (the F53/encoder-3seed positive). It closes it in the INFORMATIVE direction: not a null that leaves 'maybe a better encoder exists' open, but a case where the encoder measurably IS better on the image side and measurably DOES reorganise the spectrum while the deployed metric still declines. The binding constraint is therefore the selection/fusion path and the length-organised retrieval geometry, both of which the swap left untouched (rho ~ +0.91 either way). RECOMMENDATION AS RECORDED: park the encoder-swap axis; do NOT re-propose a different VLM tower at 4-8B on HateMM; if the encoder axis is ever reopened it should be on the TEXT side — the dominant stream, and the one Molmo2 made slightly WORSE (raw text kNN 0.8000 vs 0.8233 LoRA-curric / 0.8186 frozen Qwen). || LIMITATIONS, all pre-disclosed: (1) frozen-vs-adapted asymmetry — arm A frozen, arm B LoRA-adapted, which is exactly why arm C is carried (against the like-for-like control it is a TIE, not a loss); the PROMOTION bar is correctly set against the strongest floor since a new encoder must beat what is deployed to matter. (2) Head-size asymmetry: Molmo2's 4096-d features give the input projection ~14% more parameters than the 3584-d arms (the 32B arm at 5120-d had the same property); inherent to any cross-hidden-size encoder swap. (3) THREE FORCED prompt/resolution deviations (recon section 4): fixed 378x378 with 3x3 pooling = 648 vision tokens vs Qwen's ~1540, the <|video|> placeholder preceding the user turn, and injected per-frame timestamps — these are what 'video-native' MEANS and cannot be removed without defeating the swap, so this is an ENCODER-AS-SHIPPED comparison, not a single-variable ablation. (4) fp32->bf16 cast of the checkpoint, matched to the deployed compute dtype but a real difference from the weights as shipped. (5) CPU-trained heads compared only against CPU-trained floors (parity at 4dp confirmed). (6) Raw-space geometry is PRE-HEAD and therefore diagnostic; the deployed pipeline sees these features only through learned projections, so the Hadamard-degeneration story is a mechanism hypothesis, not a measurement of the deployed fusion. (7) All test quantities are SINGLE-DRAW DESCRIPTIVE READS; val-selection used val only (warmup >= 5), the final-epoch protocol selects nothing, and NO test number selected anything. No formal/GPU 3-seed cell was started; this probe selects nothing and promotes nothing.

READOUT = the DEPLOYED EOS-class tail, UNTOUCHED (S1/S1b had already closed the readout route), which also keeps the frozen KS-MNTP-1 bars valid without reinterpretation. COST: jobs 13658 smoke (S1_LIMIT=4) 00:02:05, 13659 belt-4 floor probe 00:08:55, 13660 full extraction both datasets train+dev 00:49:20 = 01:00:20 = 1.006 GPU-h against a ~1.0 budget; campaign total S1 + S1b + S2a = 2.697 GPU-h. Cache sanity PASS: 1508 rows (744/107 HateMM + 579/78 MHC_zh), id order identical to causal on every split, NO test_seen *mntp* file; md5 HateMM train cebf42d6e9bb0772504dcae4c157d4c6 / dev 77687475a690212d005a0a168764f07b, MHC_zh train fc2aeff17002965c1d8c7d31afdeee76 / dev ab30cb9d12d44bfe8d0db2aaa334c6dc. || THE SIGNAL -- THE FIRST REAL MOVEMENT ON THE BIDIRECTIONAL TEXT AXIS OF THE WHOLE CAMPAIGN. HateMM text 0.7850 acc vs F72 bidir 0.7570 = +0.0280 = +0.6006 CRATER RECOVERY, the FIRST arm ever to clear the frozen 50% bar (bar50 0.7804, floor25 0.7687) => KS-MNTP-1 CONTINUE on HateMM. MHC_zh text 0.6923 vs 0.6282 = +0.0641 = +0.2941 = PARTIAL (bar50 0.7372, floor25 0.6827). BOTH SIGNS POSITIVE. Weight adaptation moves the text stream in a way THREE DIFFERENT READOUTS could not (F72 EOS-class tail, S1 all-position mean pool, S1b text-positions-only pool), which SUPPORTS THE MNTP DIRECTION and independently corroborates the S1b diagnosis that the pathology lives in the WEIGHTS/TOPOLOGY, not the readout. || WHY IT IS STILL NOT USABLE -- THE STOP IS OVERDETERMINED ON FOUR INDEPENDENT REASONS, so no single gate is load-bearing: (1) the PRE-DECLARED COLLAPSE BELT FIRES on both datasets -- within-arm cos(text,img) 0.6494/0.6550 HateMM train/dev and 0.6386/0.6433 MHC_zh, worst 0.6550/0.6433, all >= the 0.60 bar, and the declared rule is self-refutation REGARDLESS OF ACCURACY; (2) FUSION INVERTS FROM ADDITIVE TO DESTRUCTIVE -- under causal, concat BEATS the best single stream by +0.0467 (HateMM) / +0.0128 (ZH); under S2a, concat is WORSE than the best single stream by -0.0467 / -0.0256. The deployed system IS a fusion head, so a text-only gain that destroys fusion is not a usable gain, and this independently corroborates the diversity loss the belt was built to detect; (3) EVERY S2a NUMBER SITS BELOW ITS CAUSAL FLOOR, on both datasets and all three streams -- text -0.0187 HateMM / -0.1538 ZH, img -0.0280 / -0.0128, concat -0.1121 / -0.1538; (4) KS-MNTP-3 IS NOT MET AND CANNOT BE -- escalation requires Δdev >= +0.020 OVER the causal floor, and S2a text is -0.0187 below it on HateMM and -0.1538 on ZH. KS-MNTP-2 NOT RUN (belt override), so the banked 13652/13655 CPU floors remain UNSPENT. || THE COST IS GLOBAL, NOT TEXT-LOCAL: the same perturbation DEGRADES THE IMG STREAM on both datasets (-0.0374 HateMM / -0.0256 ZH vs F72 bidir; also below causal). Features move enormously -- mean per-item cos(S2a, plain-bidir) = 0.3639 (HateMM text) / 0.3076 (ZH text) and 0.65-0.72 on img. || MECHANISM: the adapter is a low-rank delta FITTED AT THE Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct WEIGHT POINT. Qwen2.5-VL's trunk was INITIALISED from Qwen2.5 and then further trained during VL pretraining, so the base has DRIFTED; the delta therefore acts as a LARGE, BLUNT PERTURBATION at the new weight point. It carries SOME of the generic 'use bidirectional context' adaptation -- enough to move text 60% of the way back -- while damaging representations the VL trunk had learned. THIS IS EXACTLY THE TRANSPLANT RISK DECLARED IN §6d.1 BEFORE THE FORK WAS BUILT, now measured. || WHAT IS REFUTED: the ZERO-TRAINING TRANSPLANT SHORTCUT to MNTP. WHAT IS NOT REFUTED: THE MNTP HYPOTHESIS ITSELF -- §6d.5 declared this exact distinction in advance and the result lands squarely on it; a transplant under-delivering at a drifted weight point is WEAK evidence about what a CORRECTLY FITTED MNTP would do. LIVE CONTINUATION = S2b: train MNTP AT OUR OWN WEIGHT POINT. S2b IS GATED ON THE USER CORPUS RULING (recon §3.4): wikitext requires relaxing the conservative/veto clause; own-split multimodal (a') is LEGAL WITHOUT a ruling but supplies only ~1.5% of the reference token budget. That is a main-loop/user decision. || BELTS -- ALL PASS: KS-MNTP-0a self-test PASS (is_causal=False on 28 modules, both datasets); CPU guard drills (combination, tag-coherence, parser, test-touch) PASS 9/9; ADAPTER SCOPE = 196 LoRA-wrapped modules (= 28x7), 0 vision-tower, 196/196 with NON-ZERO lora_B (this count is the one that proves the review fix landed -- before it, it would have read 0); BELT 1 weight-level transplant proof = 5/5 probed tensors CHANGED, max|Δ| 1.96e-02 .. 1.29e-01, rel 3.3%-21%; KS-MNTP-0b adapter-is-not-a-null-op PASS (cos 0.3639 / 0.3076 << 0.9999 bar); BELT 4 SAME-PATH DOUBLE-MERGE FLOOR (job 13659, COMPLETED 00:08:55, 60 items/split, freshly-initialised zero-init LoRA of identical shape = a true mathematical null-op [0/196 non-zero lora_B, 0/5 weight probes changed], bidir OFF, double merge, vs the banked causal cache) PASS on ALL 8 CELLS >= 0.9999 (means 1.00000000-1.00000012, worst per-item 0.99999952) => THE EXTRA MERGE IS NUMERICALLY INERT, the banked causal cache remains a VALID FLOOR, NO same-path floor extraction was required (~0.85 GPU-h saved). THIS REFINES THE F87 LESSON: F87's -0.0268 phantom drift came from a merge-vs-UNMERGED PATH difference, NOT from merge COUNT -- a second merge_and_unload of a zero delta costs nothing. || EXTERNAL REVIEW SAVED THE ARM (the pre-GPU codex gate again caught a REAL, arm-invalidating defect): NO-GO x2, then GO. BLOCKER 1 -- THE TRANSPLANT WOULD HAVE LOADED ZERO WEIGHTS: the McGill checkpoint ships keys base_model.model.layers.N..., but wrapping the OUTER Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration yields PEFT keys one '.model' deeper (the outer model's decoder sits at .model); PEFT LOADS NON-STRICTLY -- it warns and continues -- leaving every lora_B at its zero init, so the merge would have been a NO-OP and S2a would have SILENTLY DUPLICATED F72 WHILE LOOKING LIKE IT RAN. BLOCKER 2 -- undeclared vision-tower binding: suffix-matching the 7 target names on the OUTER model hits 292 modules, 96 of them in the vision tower our SFT freezes (visual.blocks.N.mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj); on model.model it hits exactly 196 = 28x7 with ZERO vision. Both confirmed empirically on meta device BEFORE fixing. FIX: _attach_second_adapter() binds to model.model (the bare Qwen2_5_VLModel; model.visual and lm_head are siblings and untouched), merges, assigns back. Further hardenings: belt 1 now requires ALL 5 probes FOUND and ALL 5 CHANGED (a partial delta must not pass); parser handles --mntp_dir=VALUE / trailing --mntp_dir / flag-shaped value; ONLY the two preregistered flag+tag combinations are accepted so a real MNTP run can never be banked under a nullop tag or vice versa. || DESIGN QUESTION FLAGGED FOR THE S2b PREREG -- RAISED, NOT RESOLVED HERE, AND NOTHING TURNS ON IT: COLLAPSE-BELT TRANSFERABILITY FROM READOUT ARMS TO WEIGHTS ARMS. The belt was designed for a READOUT pathology (S1/S1b pooled vision tokens, so text became a copy of img). S2a is a WEIGHTS arm with the readout untouched, and on HateMM the text stream KEPT -- indeed slightly WIDENED -- its margin over img (S2a +0.0561 vs causal +0.0467), which is NOT the 'text becomes a copy of img' signature the belt was written for; a reasonable reader could argue it is firing on a DIFFERENT phenomenon here. THE BAR WAS NOT MOVED: it was declared before the arm existed, and post-hoc reinterpretation of a pre-declared gate is precisely the failure mode the freeze discipline exists to prevent -- and reasons 2-4 make the stop hold regardless. S2b's own frozen prereg MUST DECLARE ITS DIVERSITY GATE FRESH, subject to 0-context review. || WHAT THIS DOES NOT LICENSE: NO goal-clause progress whatsoever; NO S2a movement over F72 may EVER be quoted as a method gain; per KS-MNTP-3 even FULL recovery would have been a MECHANISM result, not a goal result, and S2a did not reach the causal floor on any stream. H1's strong form stays REFUTED (img fine under a bare mask flip, +0.0093/+0.0128, cosine 1.000000 across three extractions); H2 stays REFUTED (S1b, F92); the ONE surviving live hypothesis in this lane is weight adaptation FITTED TO THIS MODEL = S2b, behind the corpus ruling.
